identity.title: Route detected-region metrics to typed Results and selected overlays

origin.summary: G-11 closed the deterministic source-bound connected-region adapter and Runner contract. The next dependency-ready software slice is the user-facing typed output and selected overlay workflow, while R0, maximum-C3D qualification, physical metrology, and release remain separate prerequisites.

state.current_summary: G-12 scope is fixed: present an already evaluated source-bound C3D connected-region output as typed Workbench evidence, expose per-region metrics and selection, and synchronize the selected region to the existing 2D Height Image and 3D Viewer overlay paths without adding mask generation or recipe persistence.
state.next_action: Add the Workbench typed-output projection and selected-region state, route display requests through the existing Viewer coordinator, add the shared 2D/3D overlay, then run focused and runtime evidence gates.

objective.summary: Connect C3DConnectedRegionOutput from the completed G-11 adapter to a user-facing Results/Displayed Outputs review and selected-region overlay workflow.
constraints: Keep SDK labeling and metric arithmetic in the Vision SDK and keep source/mask identity validation in the existing Studio adapter.
Accept only an already evaluated, exact current-source-bound output; do not rerun detection from presentation code.

Do not add GridPolygon or GridCircle rasterization, threshold inference, mask authoring, calibration, physical area, metrology, downstream completeness consumption, or recipe persistence in this slice.
Reuse existing Workbench MVVM, Displayed Outputs, Viewer coordinator, Height Image overlay, semantic theme, and explicit Preview/Publish/Run contracts.
A selected region must be represented by stable region identity and the same row/column cells in both 2D and 3D; selection must not mutate the recipe or source.
Keep generated test, screenshot, smoke, and report evidence physically under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab-3D-Studio.
Do not change product version, create a release, commit, push, restart the PC, or modify the 2D reference repository.

criteria.text: A current exact-source-bound C3DConnectedRegionOutput is exposed as a typed Workbench artifact with region count, foreground count, grid-index area, source identity, and per-region count/area/center/orientation/bounds available without re-execution.

The Workbench exposes stable per-region selection and an explicit Show overlay route; selection and display do not edit recipe routing, persist a new recipe artifact, or pin a non-C3D region output into comparison slots.

The selected region's exact row/column cells and neutral detected-region styling are synchronized to the existing Height Image and 3D Viewer overlay paths, with a distinct selected state and clear-on-source-change behavior.

Focused Workbench verification, current Release build, existing connected-region regression, UI smoke/runtime evidence, issue validation, and diff hygiene pass; unrun DPI/theme gates remain explicitly reported rather than claimed.

milestones.title: 2D/3D selected overlay parity

milestones.title: Verification and evidence
milestones.summary: Run focused, build, smoke, runtime, structure, and documentation gates and record evidence without overclaiming unsupported UI coverage.

context.summary: G-11 owns immutable source-bound connected-region output and per-region metric records.
G-11 owns strict source/mask validation and SDK delegation; G-12 consumes its evaluation.
Existing read-first output, coordinator, 2D overlay, and 3D overlay paths are the intended G-12 integration boundary.
